logic_group.name: libplist cross-format serialization
logic_group.description: This Logic Group targets the serialization/output paths of libplist. After parsing arbitrary input via plist_from_memory (which auto-detects binary/XML/JSON/OpenStep formats), the resulting plist tree is serialized back through multiple output format writers. The core consists of recursive tree-walking serializers: serialize_plist (binary plist output with circular reference detection and offset table construction), node_to_xml (XML output with base64 encoding and date formatting), node_to_json (JSON output with string escaping), node_to_openstep (OpenStep output with quoting logic), and node_to_string (default/limd/plutil human-readable output). The dispatcher plist_write_to_string routes to all non-binary formats based on a format enum, while plist_to_bin handles binary serialization separately. These serializers perform deep recursive walks over the plist node tree, handle type-specific encoding (dates, data blobs, unicode strings), and manage dynamic buffer growth — all areas prone to bugs under adversarial tree structures.
